conditional_skills.valuation: Required before any directly held stock can enter a strategy version.
conditional_skills.growth-earnings-model: Required if a directly held stock thesis relies on high-growth, order, unit, ASP, or AI valuation credit.

verifiers: C37 hard-gate status and C39 protocol-boundary audit
per-stock C40-C42 G0-G9 non-admission and source-archive integrity audit

C43/C44 invalidation, C45 source readiness, C46 protocol binding, C47 no-action, C48 capability-boundary, C49 authorized-route recheck, C50 general-repo yield-floor screen, C51 ETF-collar nonduplicate scope screen, C52 public option-history source screen, C53 equity-led draft-protocol controls, R20 initial audit, R20 repair plan, R21 bounded independent repair recheck, R22 bounded C52 independent source audit, R23 bounded governance-registration recheck, and R18/R19 independent source audits
R17 independent closure check for R16 repair items

depth_gates.evidence_depth: Every actual strategy instrument has dated product diligence and a linked source boundary.
depth_gates.broker_consensus_depth: Not applicable to ETF role suitability; required if a direct-stock sleeve is proposed.
depth_gates.model_depth: Frozen rules, next-session timing, cost boundary, yearly and rolling diagnostics, robustness tests, and no-action controls.
depth_gates.valuation_depth: Product-role suitability for ETF sleeves; full valuation package for any direct-stock sleeve.
depth_gates.ic_readiness: Concrete instrument/weight/action card, independent audit, and a six-month forward paper ledger before C34 paper-operable status. C53 additionally requires six complete quarterly records under unchanged rules before an independent review may consider its draft.

pass_conditions: The strategy version has a frozen actual instrument set and all instruments pass dated product-level diligence and source crosscheck.
Historical results are presented only at their evidence quality and never as a guaranteed outcome.
The operating card specifies target instruments, weights, signal formation, earliest action date, no-action conditions, and risk suspension conditions without mixing C30/R01/C34 rules.
Futures are zero weight unless separate eligibility and contract-data gates pass.
Independent audit passes and no open material strategy-design finding remains.
At least six months of continuous forward paper observations are complete before paper-operable status is asserted.
A new ETF route cannot begin a historical test until every C37 point-in-time total-return, event, execution and rights gate passes.

A direct stock cannot enter any strategy version unless that security completes G0-G9 institutional diligence, current market/valuation/liquidity work and independent review; C40-C42 are explicitly not admitted.
C39 cannot be calculated or used for an action until its locked P1-P4 data gates and two-cycle F1 forward record pass independently.
A calendar-curve route must bind its full source-field readiness audit before calculation; any incomplete frozen pair closes that version without substitution or retuning.
No formal historical strategy test may begin in the current environment until a written-rights data source closes the point-in-time, total-return, availability/revision and execution evidence gates.

A short-term general-repo route cannot be described as a stable five-percent yield floor without an evidenced floor, pre-frozen rule, complete execution history, independent annual/rolling reconstruction and forward paper observation.
R19 may accept the C50 source-bounded pre-screen only when its PASS is explicitly separated from route admission, personal-account entitlement, historical result and external action.

C51 may only retain a universal collar payoff definition and source-bounded nonadmission; it cannot reopen C13 or support a stable-five-percent, selected-product, account, historical-result or action conclusion until complete rights-cleared option-chain, execution, cost and independently rechecked evidence exists.

R20's open C51 A/B findings must remain visible as historical record; R21 may close them only for its exact hash-pinned repair snapshot, without altering the current no-admission, C13 non-reopen or C48 boundaries.

C52 may describe only the retained public SSE pages and their captured client-side query semantics. Current-day fields or dated adjustment events cannot be represented as a complete historical replay, data right, account record, collar test or strategy admission; R22 may accept only the exact source-control and bounded-query snapshot while preserving C48/C49/C51, VETO and NO_ACTION. R23 may close only R22-M-004's governance-registration follow-up and must retain every substantive data and execution blocker.

C53 may specify a fixed equity-led five-ETF paper map and fail-closed quarterly action card only when its bound ledger template can reconstruct actual weights from paper units and common valuation marks. It remains a draft until its data-rights gate, six unchanged quarterly records and independent review pass. It cannot be represented as an annual five-percent floor, a historical optimum, personal suitability, trading permission or external action.
downgrade_path: If any evidence, product, model, operational, or independent-review gate fails, retain research_only status and remove the affected product or candidate strategy rather than substitute a new product or retune after results.
